notes: The canonical machine architecture and Phase-2 contract are stored as exact ordered text parts; use their manifests to reconstruct them.
The 57-stage Arrow Chart is a discovery ledger/registry of stage types, not a universal chronological timeline.
Where historical text says a closed Sequence reopens, canonical rule is: create a new Sequence referencing the closed one.
Where historical text conflates entity termination with Sequence closure, canonical rule keeps two statuses separate.
The old nine loops are route templates, not a universal fixed count.
Assimilation and Integration are one conditional incorporation/integration operation unless a domain proves two distinct transitions.

phase2.goal: Construct/adopt Human, AI, Wisdom/Holy-Book and ASI registries into the Universal Sequence grammar, bind them to ASI Nodes/Node Brains, and close each batch through R-F-R without rewriting native source truth.

primary_brain_engine_source.architecture: 10 segments -> 240 master containers -> 3,072 operational parameters + 75 bounded engines
primary_brain_engine_source.source_rule: User approval/evident status controls Sourceborn testing authority but remains separate from independent external verification.

P2_HUMAN.legacy_native_shape: 10 Segments -> 80 Containers -> 2,560 legacy approved source parameters
P2_HUMAN.expanded_functional_shape: 10 Segments -> 80 Containers -> 3,204 fully enumerated Human-derived functional source parameters
P2_HUMAN.container_version_divergence: CON-042 Core Reasoning is 48 in the legacy 2,560 source and 42 in the v1.0 3,204 successor source; legacy rows are not deleted.
P2_HUMAN.rule: Never delete or rename legacy Human IDs. The v1 successor raises the effective Human-derived functional source count to 3,204 but does not imply every source row is HUMAN_PHYSICAL.

P2_AI.ai_capability_family_source_status: AI-CAP-001..074 APPROVED USER/EVIDENT FOR CONTROLLED TESTING IN MERGED SOURCE
P2_AI.runtime_rule: No LLM API, Transformer or next-token dependency is assumed. Existing AI systems are evidence/reverse-engineering sources, not Sourceborn runtime requirements.

brain_engine_operational_layer.pattern: 8 operational elements repeated across 10 segments, 6 sub-parameters per container

multi_rubric_wiring.rule: Universal Sequence remains the execution grammar; Human supplies human state/capability, AI supplies artificial cognition, Wisdom supplies source-linked contextual principles, and ASI supplies meta-governance.

v2_sequence_review.adoption_rule: V2 may supersede the Phase-1 canonical execution grammar only through an explicit V2 adoption/closure packet; no historical instance is rewritten.
